## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive; only Energy is positive while the rest are weak, and leadership is Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5) — two independent confirmations for NEUTRAL: extreme sector narrowness and concentrated tech outperformance amid broad sector weakness.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows leadership pockets: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND — leadership Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Healthcare lagging: AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -17.86%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -3.93%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -2.23%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -8.97% | 1M: +6.07%) CORRECTION, SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in healthcare and select tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence: AMD (sentiment -55) and INTC (sentiment -50) show bullish price action despite bearish headlines — watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but volatile: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND — pockets of chip strength offset by large-cap weakness; sector showing internal rotation with concentrated leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Soft overall: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION — Financials are not leading and show mixed short-term signals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Weak and deteriorating: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION — sentiment-driven sell-offs and trial/news hits are pressuring the group.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Energy and leading chip names: XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to weak Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary names (AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -17.86%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership due to narrow tech concentration and otherwise broad weakness.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND — watch chips and Energy.  
BEARISH: AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND — headline-driven downside risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (only sector positive this week; XOM/CVX ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary (broad weekly weakness and headline pressure).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Monitor chip follow-through above recent 1W highs for AMD/INTC/QCOM to confirm expansion; NVDA needs reclaim above its 1M range to shift from BELOW TREND. Watch AMGN and NVS for continuation below recent weekly lows as confirmation of broader healthcare risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
QCOM (+85): Qualcomm (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND — bullish headline confirmed by strong price action.  
ADBE (+70): Adobe (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price falling, divergence suggests distribution.  
VLO (+60): Valero (VLO) (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AMGN (-60): Amgen (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines confirmed by heavy price decline.  
AMD (-55): AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price up, a divergence to monitor.  
INTC (-50): Intel (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND — bearish sentiment vs strong short-term performance; watch for potential re-pricing.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership given extreme narrowness of winners. AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow tech concentration and multiple sentiment/price divergences (AMD/INTC vs negative headlines; ADBE/AMGN headline-driven weakness) — monitor for trend confirmation.
